newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's maritime transport rose 7.5 pct in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's maritime transport rose 7.5 pct in 1996.

text.p: Morocco's merchant maritime transport activity rose 7.4 percent to 5.15 million tonnes in 1996, worth $230 million, a spokesman said.
It generated a turnover of 2.16 billion dirhams ($230 million) in 1996, a slight drop of one percent compared with the previous period, the merchant maritime directorate said.
Europe remains Morocco's main commercial partner with 90 percent of total trade exchanges, it said.

Morocco's shipment of citrus and other agro-industry products -- which represented the main merchandise transported in 1996 -- maintained a stable trend compared with past recent years, the directorate added.
Total volume of trade transport from and to Morocco, including international shipment was 39 million tonnes in 1996.
